out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. OBSERVED PAPER TOWELS NOT WITHIN ARMS REACH OF BOTH HAND SINKS.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. EHS DISCUSSED WITH CFM THAT PAPER TOWELS MUST BE WITHIN REACH OF HAND SINK.

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: OBSERVED SOILED DISHWARE IN BASIN OF HAND SINK NEXT TO 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. EHS DISCUSSED WITH CFM THAT HAND SINK MUST REMAIN CLEAR AND ONLY USED FOR HAND WASHING.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED CARTON OF RAW SHELL EGGS ON TOP SHELF ABOVE RTE FOODS IN WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM MOVED RAW SHELL EGGS TO BOTTOM SHELF.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils/Linens Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: OBSERVED CARDBOARD BOXES FOR TO-GO ORDERS STORED ON FLOOR IN FRONT KITCHEN NEAR COFFEE/TEA PREPARATION AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned equipment and utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination, and at least 6 inches off the floor on NSF approved shelving units or dunnage racks. CFM WILL MOVE BOXES OFF FLOOR ONTO STORAGE SHELVING.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. OBSERVED NO BLEACH TEST STRIPS AVAILABLE.
violations.corrective_action: CFM ORDERED BLEACH TEST STRIPS. EHS PROVIDED TEST STRIPS TO CFM. CFM TO PROVIDE PROOF OF PURCHASE TO EHS.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM PRESENT DURING BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE CHANGE TASKS WITHOUT REMOVING GLOVES, WASHING HANDS, AND PLACING NEW GLOVES ON.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. CFM REMINDED ALL EMPLOYEES TO CHANGE GLOVES AND WASH HANDS WHEN CHANGING TASKS.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: OBSERVED RAW CHICKEN STORED ON SHELF ABOVE RAW BEEF IN M3 3 DR UC.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). CFM MOVED CHICKEN TO BOTTOM SHELF/GAVE TO EMPLOYEE TO BEGIN PREPARING.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. OBSERVED SPRAY BOTTLE OF CLEANER AT HAND SINK NEXT TO VERTICAL BROILERS.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CFM LABELLED SPRAY BOTTLE WITH CLEANER NAME. KOLBEH (Inspection Date: 12/19/2024) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: OBSERVED VARIOUS SQUEEZE BOTTLES OF OIL, SAUCE, ETC WITH NO COMMON NAME.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM WILL HAVEEMPLOYEE LABEL ALL BOTTLES WITH FOOD NAME.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed containers of food and drink stored on the floor throughout kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CFM will move all food items onto storage racks.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: OBSERVED MIGALI 2 DR PREP AT 48F. CFM STATED UNIT RUNS COLD AND FOOD FREEZES. CFM TOGGLED UNIT TO THE “ON” POSITION
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EHS RECOMMENDED REPAIR OF UNIT TO MAINTAIN PROPER COLD HOLDING TEMPERATURES.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. OBSERVED NO BLEACH TEST KIT IN FACILITY.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed caulking between 3 compartment sink and wall in need of cleaning/replacing.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. CFM will clean/replace caulking.
